ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "On Hold"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Abort") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Proposal"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Solution Presentation") ), $Profile.Id <> "00egK000001qs5N" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Cannot move to On Hold or Abort from Proposal or Solution Presentation stage."
